records.description: Kanta Ben is an experimental crowd-sourced application that connects skilled professionals with potential customers of at-home services. The app can be used by both professionals(like carpenters, painters) to upload their data and customers to contact them.

records.name: Trumpet
records.tagline: Alerts when Trump moves the market
records.description: "We're one Truth Social post away from being up or down 5% every day" — Bill Eigen, Portfolio Manager at JP Morgan. How Trumpet works: Trump sends market-moving posts > You receive alert notifications from Trumpet > Profit 📈

records.name: Repathon
records.tagline: Turn workouts into a game. AI-powered plans, real progress.
records.description: Repathon is a gamified AI-powered fitness app that keeps you consistent with smart workout plans, levels, XP, challenges, and social motivation all in your pocket.

records.name: GTAIC
records.tagline: IaaS platform to create market research reports on demand
records.description: An innovative platform that enables users to create market research reports on demand. With coverage spanning over 110 countries and 5,600 goods, users can generate comprehensive reports in just minutes, leveraging the latest official market data.

records.name: ShuTaikin
records.tagline: Making your work hours more visible, meaningful, and social.
records.description: ShuTaikin is a simple app to track and share your work hours. Just tap to clock in/out, view charts of your working patterns, and share your logs anonymously on a social timeline. Perfect for anyone who wants to reflect on how they work.

records.name: Gro: Your Path to Financial Freedom
records.tagline: Simple budget tracking to achieving financial independence
records.description: From daily transaction tracking to long-term financial planning like achieving Financial Independence, Retire Early (FIRE). All core features are totally free and secure. Your financial freedom starts here!

records.name: Saas Secret Scanner
records.tagline: Sanfransisco/homebrew-tap
records.description: Clipboard security tool that detects and sanitizes leaked secrets for small to large organizations using GenAI

records.name: 3DModelTools - Convert images to GLB
records.tagline: Turn image into 3D GLB files—fast, simple, and browser-based
records.description: Quickly turn your image (JPG, PNG) into a GLB 3D model—ideal for designers, WebGL, AR, or 3D printing. Simple, fast, no software install. Preview online and download instantly. Start with 10 free conversions.

records.name: Newstream
records.tagline: Stay informed on-the-go, effortlessly with AI briefs
records.description: 🎧 Meet your new morning routine! Newstream turns top news from your favourite topics into AI-generated audio briefs, so you can catch up hands-free while on the go. The PoC is almost there 🚀 I need your feedback! 🤖 Do you think it's the app the world needs?

records.name: miniB HTML editor
records.tagline: Fully featured WYSIWIG html editor for use in your projects
records.description: Fully featured WYSIWYG HTML editor for use in your web development projects, CMS and customer websites for adding and managing content and posts

records.name: SignCall
records.tagline: Dukung Komunikasi, Pahami Bahasa Isyarat
records.description: SignCall officially launches as a web-based sign language translator and browser extension, offering real-time gesture detection via webcam. Designed for seamless communication and self-learning, it also integrates with Google Meet and supports premium access.

records.name: Whoozit
records.tagline: Your skills.your story. create your stunning digital profile
records.description: Whoozit is your free, customizable link-in-bio builder. Organize all your important links on one stunning, mobile-optimized page. Control what you share with public/private settings. No coding needed – tell your story, showcase your skills!

records.name: Eyrie
records.tagline: The schema-first platform for building and deploying apps
records.description: The Eyrie platform allows developers to rapidly deploy applications to a managed cloud platform without any extra setup on their end. All Eyrie needs is an API contract and it will take care of the rest allowing one to focus on what's important: business logic

records.name: DocuChampAI
records.tagline: AI that "Sees" Images, Charts, Tables and even Handwritings
records.description: Transform your document workflow with AI. Extract data from PDFs, analyze charts & tables, automate reports. Built for professionals who value efficiency over copy-paste workflows.

records.name: crideros
records.tagline: Your AI-powered control center for real work
records.description: CriderOS is your all-in-one AI command center. Manage projects, automate tasks, run mods, and flex your workflow—all powered by real AI. Built for creators, coders, hustlers. Early access—get in before it blows up.
